name: Chocolate Peanut Butter Smoothie Bowl
description: This Chocolate Peanut Butter Banana Smoothie Bowl tastes like a peanut butter cup, but it's actually a filling, superfood-packed breakfast that comes together in just 5 minutes! This gluten-free + vegan smoothie bowl is the perfect easy vegan breakfast.
author: Rachel Conners
ingredients: 2 scoops protein powder of your choice
1 tablespoon chia seeds (flax seeds, or hemp seeds)
instructions: Combine bananas, almond milk, peanut butter, cacao powder, and collagen, maca powder, and chia seeds if using, in a blender (I used my Vitamix). Puree until completely smooth - the mixture should be thick. Add a touch more liquid if necessary to get it to blend completely smooth.
Transfer to a bowl and all of your favorite toppings. Serve immediately, and enjoy!
